messages:
lauren-sre: incidentbot stopped sending pages for critical notify events. PagerDuty webhook returning 502 from notify-bridge since ~10:02 UTC. Customers seeing delayed failover. Anyone oncall? :warning:

incidentbot: [automated] Detected 502 responses from /webhook/notify at 2026-03-15T10:02:31Z. Suppressing retry flood and pausing automatic pages.

jay-ops: I'm oncall, looking now. Can someone paste the error snippet from notify-bridge logs?

lauren-sre: logs below:
```
[ERROR] 2026-03-15T10:02:31Z notify-bridge proxy -> pager-proxy responded 502: upstream timed out after 15s (POST /v1/pager)
queue_publish_retries=12
```

alex-infra: we rotated pager-proxy certs last night. certs look valid. checking notify-bridge consumer group and redis backlog.

michael-platform: seeing a large publish queue on notify-bridge: pending_publish=48000, consumer_lag=~47k. Restarting notify-bridge worker group B to clear stuck tasks.

jay-ops: can we do manual pages in the meantime? Support reporting ~8 customer tickets, EU customers on premium SLA hit latency 5+ mins. Suggest manual SMS rollcall to cover until automated paging healthy.

lauren-sre: yep. Start manual SMS rollcall. @oncall-sre DM phone tree and run the emergency rollcall. I'll open a PagerDuty incident and mark "manual paging active" in the incident notes.

oncall-sre: ack. Triggering emergency SMS relay script now: `./scripts/sms_rollcall --team=sre --skip-confirm`

lauren-sre: manual pages sent to 6 devs, 4 acked so far. Keeping manual until consumers healthy and no duplicate risk. Incidentbot still suppressed due to 502 responses.

alex-infra: notify-bridge workers restarted, queue draining. pending_publish=120 now. Watch for any duplicate deliveries as tasks are reprocessed.

incidentbot: [automated] Recovered webhook connection to pager-proxy at 2026-03-15T10:09:58Z. Un-suppressing automatic retries. NOTE: system will NOT resend alerts that were manually delivered; they will be marked as handled to avoid duplicates.

michael-platform: follow-ups: 1) increase notify-bridge consumer concurrency, 2) add threshold alert for publish_queue > 10k, 3) investigate proxy timeout and backpressure handling (15s seems low for current load).

lauren-sre: :white_check_mark: mitigation complete for now. Creating postmortem ticket ENG-4567 and assigning to alex-infra for RCA. Please include timeline + customer impact (tickets/regions) and action items.

alex-infra: on it — I'll gather traces, broker logs, and the worker group exit codes and post summary to #postmortems when ready.
